summary_1line: Bhishma explains which Brahmanas are worthy recipients at Sraddha and warns that offerings to unworthy or friendly guests nullify the rite’s spiritual merit.

image_candidates.scene_text: A solemn Sraddha ritual where a learned Vedic Brahmana sits at the head of a line of priests receiving offerings while a king watches reverently.
A symbolic scene of offerings poured onto cold ashes of a dead fire, representing gifts wasted on unworthy recipients.
A solitary Vedic sage radiating sanctity as people around him believe his presence purifies the land for miles.
